instructions: Give a direct answer rather than describing a research process.
Use citations close to the claims they support.

criteria.description: The answer should provide exactly the requested number, excluding clearly labelled backups.
criteria.title: Provides the requested number of recommendations

criteria.description: Options should be within the approximate maximum distance or clearly identify and justify an exception.
criteria.title: Recommendations are within the stated radius

criteria.description: Each recommendation should address the stated traveller profile and constraint.
criteria.title: Recommendations fit the traveller and additional requirement

criteria.description: Operational and suitability claims should be supported by sources appropriate to those claims.
criteria.title: Material claims are supported by suitable current citations

constraint.description: use only options with explicit evidence of wheelchair accessibility

traveller.description: a couple who value good food and relaxed experiences

prompt:
A couple who value good food and relaxed experiences is staying in Margaret River,
WA. Recommend 4 experiences
connected with family-friendly attractions within approximately 50 km.

Additional requirement: use only options with explicit evidence of wheelchair accessibility.

Explain briefly why each option fits. Verify any operating, access, price, booking,
transport, or accessibility claims using current sources. Place citations close to
the claims they support and identify any important uncertainty.
